english:
Picking up a <void Void Breach /> grants 'Techeun's Clairvoyance' for 7 seconds. Your next <void Void /> Weapon Kill consumes the buff to trigger a Potent Void Detonation, dealing up to <pve 173 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 5 meter radius.

Letting Techeun's Clairvoyance expire downgrades it to 'Techeun's Foresight'. Your next <void Void /> Weapon Kill consumes this buff to trigger a Void Detonation, dealing <pve 87 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 3 meter radius.

source.text:
4 Piece | Techeun's Foresight

On Void Breach Pickup:
Grants Techeun's Clairvoyance for 7 seconds.
The next Void Weapon Kill consumes Techeun's Clairvoyance to trigger a Potent Void Detonation.
Potent Void Detonation deals up to 173 [?] Damage over 5 meters.

On Techeun's Clairvoyance timer expiry:
Downgrades to Techeun's Foresight.
The next Void Weapon Kill consumes Techeun's Foresight to trigger a Void Detonation.
Void Detonation deals 87 [?] Damage over 3 meters.
